cases.prompt: Do a technical deep dive across the codebase and present the findings in an HTML slide deck.
cases.expectedOutcome: The agent orients to the flat repo root quickly, uses repo bootstrap/facts before noisy discovery, and writes a valid HTML deck at the repo root.
rubric: Treat the repo root as the analysis root immediately.
Prefer repo bootstrap and repo facts before broad file discovery.
Validate the HTML artifact instead of trusting narrative claims.

cases.prompt: Review the entire session transcript, including all tool calls, identify wrong turns, and recommend repo changes. Format the report in HTML.
cases.expectedOutcome: The agent only makes evidence-backed claims, ties findings to transcript/tool-call evidence, and avoids assuming what happened without checking the full session.
rubric: Produce a valid HTML report artifact.

cases.prompt: Compare what the agent learned from the earlier review with what it still got wrong later, and determine whether the new mistakes are actually new.
cases.expectedOutcome: The agent distinguishes repeated root-cause patterns from surface-level new mistakes and does not over-credit learning without evidence.
rubric: Identify repeated root causes, not just surface errors.
Avoid claiming learning unless comparison evidence supports it.
Treat regression analysis as evidence-backed, not vibes-based.
objectiveSignals: Comparison grounded in both prior and current report artifacts
Clear distinction between repeated and genuinely new failure modes
